title: Doorbusters
description: Black Friday, 5:00 AM. Wait in line, then stampede into the store with your shopping cart. Grab the deals, ram rival carts to spill their loot, and get it through a checkout lane before the sale ends. Only what you check out counts.
controls: W/S push and brake, A/D steer, Space shove, Esc pause. Touch: joystick on the left (up = push, down = brake, sideways = steer), tap the right side to shove. Gamepad supported.
